Class OmieCheckingAccountProvider

Omie checking accounts (geral/contacorrente/) — the list an application offers so the user can pick where the receivable of a service order lands (nCodCC, required on inclusion).

Blocked accounts are left out: Omie lists them but does not accept entries on them.

GetAsync(bool, CancellationToken)

Usable checking accounts of the account's registration. With forceRefresh the cache is ignored and rewritten with whatever Omie returns — what a "reload from the ERP" action needs, since the cached list would otherwise be served for the next 30 minutes and the button would look inert.
